name: cavemio-icon-morph
title: Icon morph
description: One icon becoming another: blur pop, direction-aware turn, card flip, or strokes that draw themselves. Fast toggling never jumps.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Driven by the Web Animations API: each change starts from the layer's current pose, so a second press mid-morph turns it back.
- draw works with stroke icons (lucide and the like): every path, line and circle is drawn by its own length.
- The icon is aria-hidden; IconMorphButton carries the name and aria-pressed.
- Reduced motion: a 160ms crossfade, no scale, turn or draw.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: from / to
props.description: – · The two icons; active picks to.

props.name: icons / value
props.description: – · Any number of icons by name; value picks one. Their order sets the direction of rotate and flip.

props.name: mode
props.description: "blur" · How the icons trade places. "scale" still works as the old name for "blur".

props.name: size
props.description: 16 · Box size in px; icons fill it.

props.name: IconMorphButton
props.description: – · A 28/36/40px toggle (sm/md/lg; ghost, outline, solid) with aria-pressed, active/defaultActive/onActiveChange and a required label.

useCases.title: Media players & audio controls
useCases.description: Play/Pause and Mute/Unmute state swaps with harmonic spring settle.

useCases.title: Navigation headers
useCases.description: Mobile hamburger menu morphing into an X close button.

useCases.title: Password fields
useCases.description: Eye to EyeOff toggle with soft depth blur.

features.title: Three morph modes
features.description: Supports scale with soft depth blur, planar rotate (0° → 90°), and 3D horizon flip (rotateY).

features.title: Standalone & button variants
features.description: Use as a standalone kinetic icon primitive (IconMorph) or as an interactive button (IconMorphButton).

features.title: Concentric thin line pill
features.description: Button variant includes outline, ghost, and solid styles with active scale damping.

features.title: Harmonic spring curve
features.description: Transitions use cubic-bezier(0.22, 1.18, 0.36, 1) for a subtle 3% organic breath.

states.title: blur
states.description: The old icon shrinks to 0.6 into a 3px blur (200ms) while the new one pops out of it with a slight overshoot (440ms).

states.title: rotate
states.description: A quarter turn that keeps its direction: forward turns clockwise, back turns the other way (480ms).

states.title: flip
states.description: The old face turns edge-on (170ms), then the new one comes round from behind (500ms).

states.title: draw
states.description: The new icon's strokes draw themselves one after another (420ms, 60ms apart) as the old one blurs away.
